body:
If we assume 7.3.3 is a pre-requisite to prevent 7.3.1, then 7.3.3 goes before 7.3.1. That also means 7.3.1 (about log injection in log viewing software) becomes an L2 as it’s behind the scenes and not easily reached in most penetration tests. 

Make 7.3.1 L2 / L3
Move 7.3.3 to 7.3.1
Renumber V7.3
Replace “Log encoding (7.3.3)” with “Log encoding (7.3.1)”
title: Reorder 7.3.3 and 7.3.1, make 7.3.1 L2
